title: Development of a Canadian Bronchiectasis and NTM Database
official: Development of a Canadian Bronchiectasis and NTM Database
summary: The investigators aim to develop a comprehensive patient registry of patients with non-CF bronchiectasis and/or Nontuberculosis Mycobacteria (NTM)
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Over the age of 18
* Non-CF Bronchiectasis
* Nontuberculosis Mycobacteria (NTM)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Under the age of 18
* CF bronchiectasis
